stop_rules.note: a 429 pauses 5 minutes and the same request is tried once more; a second 429 in a row stops the run with the cursor saved; no retry loop

privacy_rules: no account, portfolio, order, fill, position or key endpoint (the runner refuses them)
no Authorization header, no key, no cookie
response bodies go to scratch outside the repository and are never committed; only the status read log is committed
purpose: REPLACES the 17+ page historical NBA walk and the 300 to 500 candle reads. One page (100) of OPEN combos for each of three collections, to answer the only question the zero-ask finding left: does any open combo show a real two-sided quote (ask between 0.01 and 0.99, bid above 0, ask minus bid at most 0.10) now? NBA is in season, so open NBA combos should exist; the earlier read of the other two found only 37 stale open combos. Zero quoted combos in 3 pages closes COMBO1 for good.
will_not_decide: does not price or score any combo (R1, R2, R3 stay unrun)
a quoted combo only means the ask/bid test should be re-run with a recorder; it is not an edge
